dialogues.speaker: Vakhrushina
dialogues.text: He wants to drink his worries away, but he's afraid he'll make a scene. He wants to have fun for once, but he still has too much on his mind.

dialogues.speaker: Vakhrushina
dialogues.text: So I suppose he'll just drown his sorrows in Fonta and end up even sadder. Or in milk, maybe. That's his choice.
